name: Back Extension
summary: A bodyweight hip-hinge exercise on a hyperextension bench that strengthens the lower back, glutes and hamstrings.
setup: Adjust the pad so it sits just below your hip bones and your ankles are secured under the rollers.
Cross your arms over your chest or hold them lightly behind your head.
Start with your body in a straight line from head to heels.
execution: Hinge forward at the hips, lowering your torso with a neutral spine until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Keep your neck in line with your spine.
Squeeze your glutes and raise your torso back up until your body forms a straight line.
Stop at a straight line instead of hyperextending your lower back.
mistakes: Hyperextending at the top: finish when your body is in a straight line.
Rounding the spine at the bottom: stop the descent where you can keep a neutral back.
Using momentum: slow down and use a controlled tempo.
Pad too high so the hips cannot hinge: set it just below the hips.
